sentences.text: In brief prosecution case is that on 1.3.2023 at 4.55 complainant Khairu Dhakad along with Balveer Dhakad, Bharat Chidar, Sachin Dhakad, Ajeet Dhakad and Anil Dhakad in injured condition lodged a report against present appellants Raghunath Singh Dhakad and Bachchu @ Bachan Lal Chidar and ten others that in the morning at 10 am he along with Bharat Chidar was sitting near the shop of Ramkrishna Dhakad, at that time, Mukesh Dhakad, Thakurlal Dhakad and Dinesh Yadav came on bullet motorcycle and by abusing asked to compromise the matter under Section 376 of IPC.

The complainant replied that if he will compromise the matter, then he will also compromise the matter,
at that juncture, from bolero vehicle No.MP 33 C 4918 appellants and other co- accused persons came armed with Lathi, Farsa, Lohangi and Ballam.

Accused Mukesh took out Farsa from the vehicle and assaulted on the head of the complainant, due to which blood started oozing out,
accused Thakurlal assaulted with Lohangi on his left hand palm, appellant Raghunath assaulted with Lathi on his left shoulder.

When Bharat Chidar came to save the complainant, Manoj Dhakad,
Govind Dhakad, Dinesh Yadav, Rajdhar Dhakad and Awdhesh Dhakad committed Marpeet with him by kicks and fists.
When Balveer Dhakad came to save, Ramkrishna Dhakad assaulted with Lohangi on his wrist of left hand and Nattha Jatav pelted stone which hit near his right shoulder.
Son of complainant Sachin when intervened in the matter, Manoj assaulted with Ballam on his head and Ishwarlal Dhakad assaulted with Lathi on his right hand.

Appellant Bachchu assaulted with Lathi on the right shoulder of Anil Dhakad and Mukesh assaulted with blunt side of Farsa on the head of Ajeet Dhakad and Awdhesh assaulted with Lathi on his left hand.
They also damaged Passion Pro motorcycle of the complainant.
On his report, crime for the aforesaid offences has been registered.
Appellants have been arrested on 16.3.2023.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
I t is submitted by learned counsel for appellants that appellants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the case.
They are in custody since 16.3.2023.

It is further submitted that on the report of Mukesh Dhakad (accused in the present case) cross-case bearing crime No.60/2023 has been registered against the complainant party under Section 305, 147, 148, 149, 323, 294, 506, 427, 353 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(da), 3(1)(dha) and 3(2)(va) in regard to the same incident.
Investigation has been complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take some time.
They undertake to cooperate in trial and to abide by the conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
On such circumstances, learned counsel for the appellants prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the criminal appeal and prayed for its rejection.

Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and considered the arguments advanced by them and perused the case-diary.

sentences.text:
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting SOODAN PRASAD on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that appeal should be allowed Signing time:
21-04-2023 07:11:51 PM

and by allowing the appeal and setting aside the order dated 17.4.2023 passed by the trial Court, it is ordered that if appellants furnish cash security of Rs. 25,000/- each alongwith bail bond o f Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, they should be released on bail.
Appellants will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving them any notice.
Appeal stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ms/-
